verdict.rationale: WooCommerce publishes REST API reference documentation (docs-11, docs-27, docs-44, docs-x1/x2) but there is no evidence of an interactive, runnable API console (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI explorer); a direct probe for OpenAPI/Swagger specs on the developer site returned 404 on all candidate paths (woocommerce-probe-2), indicating no interactive reference exists.
